title: Sum and largest: array vs slice
hints: `for _, v := range x { ... }` works the same way over an array and a slice. Ranging over a nil slice simply runs zero times.
Keep a running `total := 0` and add each `v`. For `Largest`, handle `len(s) == 0` first, then use `s[0]` as the starting value.
`largest = s[0]`, then `for _, v := range s[1:] { if v > largest { largest = v } }` and `return largest, true`.
